planSummary: Ramp pattern follows the Acme SD phase closely for design-heavy roles; Site Observation staffing starts two weeks into Construction Management, once the contractor mobilizes on site.

roles.rationale: Mirrors the Acme SD phase's front-loaded pattern — heavier early weeks for site analysis and concept massing, tapering as design converges. Winds down entirely by week 8 as SD wraps.
Steady mid-level involvement across the full CM duration, lighter than Globex's comparable CA phase since this contract has fewer RFI-heavy trades.
Doesn't start until week 4 — two weeks after CM kicks off, once the contractor mobilizes on site. Peaks mid-construction matching typical inspection cadence seen across all three comparable projects.
